news.title: Fifa reportedly allowed DR Congo into World Cup despite ineligible player in qualifying
news.lede: Nigeria filed complaint over ineligible players in playoff. Fifa investigators aware of situation before tournament. Fifa allowed the Democratic Republic of the Congo to compete at this summer’s World Cup despite reports suggesting an internal investigation found that the country had fielded an ineligible player in qualifying. The player in question, the goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi, starred for his nation at the tournament, including against England in the last 32.

news.title: Football Australia confirms match officials for Hahn Australia Cup 2026 Final
news.lede: Football Queensland’s Faghani will be joined by assistant referees Luke Gennimatas (Football Victoria) and Claire Green (Football Tasmania), with Caitlin Williams (Football Victoria) appointed as fourth official. Shaun Evans (Football Victoria) will serve as Video Assistant Referee (VAR), supported by Maddy Allum (Football NSW) as Assistant Video Assistant Referee (AVAR). The Final will mark the first use of VAR in the Hahn Australia Cup, providing additional support to the on-field officiating team. Faghani brings extensive international experience, having refereed the 2016 Olympic Men’s Football Final, the 2018 FIFA World Cup™ third-place play-off and the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup™ Final.

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: I am the one who chose Jesus to lead Portugal
news.lede: Ronaldo reveals he has backed away from retiring from international football after the World Cup. Cristiano Ronaldo has revealed that he helped pick Jorge Jesus to lead Portugal, stressing he had planned to retire from international football after the 2026 World Cup before the federation president talked him out of it. The Portugal captain had found himself at the centre of a major crisis with Jesus, after the Don spent the entire Norway match on the substitutes' bench in the second round of the UEFA Nations League group stage. Jesus poured fuel on the fire.

news.title: Football: Thapa Scores But India Go Down 1-6 To Strong Uruguayan Side
news.lede: Kolkata: The national senior men s football team ended its international window with a disappointing 1-6 defeat to two-time World Cup winner Uruguay at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Kriranga in Kolkata on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa scored the lone goal for India in the 22nd minute to level an early goal from the penalty spot by Darwin Nunez in the 12th minute. The visitors then scored five times, with Maxi Araujo scoring a brace of goals in the 28th and 59th minutes. Rodrigo Zalazar (53rd), JM Sanabria (71st), and Rodrigo Aguirre (86th minute) secured a comfortable victory.

news.title: He did not complete the procedure to play for Congo, but FIFA allowed him to play in the World Cup.
news.lede: The International Football Federation (FIFA) knew before the World Cup that Congolese goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi was ineligible when he played in several qualifying matches, but allowed him to continue playing in the tournament held this summer in the USA, Canada and Mexico, world media reported today. The New York Times and the French daily Le Monde cited internal FIFA documents on the Mpasi case, further intensifying the focus on the disciplinary procedures of the world football body under president Gianni Infantino. As reported, the 32-year-old Mpasi was a member of the French under-17 national team, but never completed the procedure before FIFA for a change, that is, for the right to play for Congo, with which he has family ties.
